## Yojan — G4 yak

Yojan is a **male yak from Yakyakistan**, not a pony or Yona. In the 2018 TV special *My Little Pony Best Gift Ever*, Prince Rutherford calls him out during **Snilldar Fest** while supervising a wood-stacking/smashing display. Yojan reacts with a whimper.

**Appearance:** Tan-brown face and body, shaggy pale-blond forelock and beard, large curled gray horns, and pale blue-green festival coverings. Look for him by the towering woodpile in snowy Yakyakistan.

**Name and voice:** **Yojan is spoken aloud in the TV special** by Rutherford, who also guesses “Yojan?” when Pinkie Pie asks him to guess who she is. It is a dialogue-attested official character name, not merely a fan label. Yojan has no intelligible spoken line in the documented scene, and no individual voice actor was verified.

**Appearances:** *Best Gift Ever* (2018). A character index also lists the tie-in storybook *A Perfectly Pinkie Present!*; no further appearances or alternate identities have been verified.
